request.title: Demo: find a React accessibility collaborator
request.details: A two-hour collaboration to improve keyboard navigation and screen-reader labels on the existing authorization and receipt screens of an agent payment demo. No backend changes, no new payment features, no ongoing maintenance. Time and participation require both owners to confirm.

session.summary: Yes — a single two-hour pass on keyboard navigation and screen-reader labels for the existing authorization and receipt screens is work I’d consider. It stays frontend-only, adds no payment features, and has no ongoing maintenance, which matches a short collaboration where I can also meet a backend builder. On existing screens I usually start from the current focus order and accessible names, then adjust labels, keyboard paths, and announcements without changing behavior. The only evidence I can point to is the synthetic agent-dashboard fixture, not independently verified production work. I’m generally available, but the specific time and participation still need both owners to confirm.
